[!dolt] skip
# Test bd count basic and grouped output
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Bug issue' --description 'Needs fixing' --type bug --priority 1
bd create 'Feature issue' --description 'Needs building' --type feature --priority 2

bd count
stdout '^2$'

bd count --status open
stdout '^2$'

bd count --by-type
stdout 'Total: 2'
stdout 'bug: 1'
stdout 'feature: 1'

! bd count --by-status --by-type
stderr 'only one --by-'
